description: This file defines the KpiDao class, a data access object responsible for handling CRUD operations and queries related to KPI entities within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting KPIs, as well as verifying whether KPIs are editable or deletable based on their associations with performance reviews and reviewer ratings.

classes.name: KpiDao
classes.description: Data access object class for handling KPI related database operations within the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Persists a KPI entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getKpiById
methods.description: Retrieves a KPI entity by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingKpiIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of KPIs from a provided list that currently exist and are not deleted.

methods.name: getKpiList
methods.description: Fetches a list of KPIs based on specific search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a query builder wrapper for fetching KPIs with optional filtering by job title.

methods.name: getDefaultKpi
methods.description: Retrieves the default KPI entity marked with 'defaultKpi'.

methods.name: deleteKpi
methods.description: Marks KPIs as deleted, provided their IDs, considering whether they are associated with active performance reviews.

methods.name: unsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Unsets the default KPI flag for all KPIs, optionally excluding one by ID.

methods.name: isKpiEditable
methods.description: Determines if a KPI is editable by checking for existing reviewer ratings linked to active reviews.

methods.name: isKpiDeletable
methods.description: Checks whether a KPI can be deleted by verifying the absence of reviewer ratings linked to inactive reviews.
